items.title: Congress Set to Leave Washington for the Midterms With No A.I. Progress
items.description: Senate Democrats blocked a measure that would encourage, but not require, states to protect consumers from power rate hikes tied to data center growth, and had no limits on A.I. use or deployment.

items.title: Panic and Heroics on FlyDubai Flight: ‘We Felt That This Was It’

items.title: FlyDubai Flight to Israel Diverted After Clash Between Pilots: What We Know and Don’t Know
items.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel said one of the pilots may have been attempting to crash the flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The plane landed in Saudi Arabia and all passengers were safe.

items.title: Democrats Block Stock-Trading Bill, Denying the G.O.P. a Pre-Midterm Win

items.title: Becerra and Hilton to Face Off in Televised California Governor Debate
items.description: Xavier Becerra, a Democrat who served in the Biden administration, will debate Steve Hilton, a Republican former talk show host, in what’s likely to be their only face-off before the election.

items.title: Andrea Shaw Says Vaccines Killed Her Twins. Authorities Say She Suffocated Them.

items.title: Fed’s Watchdog Finds No Misconduct or Illegal Activity in Costly Renovations

items.title: Justice Dept. Tries to Rebuke Federal Judges for Speaking to The Times
